page_title: NEW 1-0 MNU | Newcastle v Manchester Utd 02/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' That's the end of the match.
90+7' Substitution. Matt Ritchie (Newcastle Utd) replaces Anthony Gordon.
90+7' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) infringed the rules and goes into the book. Robert Jones pulls out a yellow card.
90+5' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
90+4' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
90+2' Antony (Manchester United) has tested the patience of referee Robert Jones and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
90' The fourth official shows 9 min. of added time.
90' The attendance is 52214.
89' Harry Maguire (Manchester United) has a goal ruled out for offside!
88' Luke Shaw (Manchester United) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
86' Nick Pope is substituted due to injury. Eddie Howe gives a chance to Martin Dubravka (Newcastle Utd).

83' Sergio Reguilon (Manchester United) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
83' Manchester Utd take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

82' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. Now Manchester Utd have a corner.
81' The foul by Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) was seen by Robert Jones who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
80' Erik ten Hag decides to make a substitution. Kobbie Mainoo will be replaced by Sofyan Amrabat (Manchester United).
80' Substitution. Sergio Reguilon (Manchester United) on for Aaron Wan-Bissaka.
79' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.

79' Lewis Miley (Newcastle Utd) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players. Newcastle win a corner.
77' Harry Maguire (Manchester United) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Robert Jones had an easy-decision to make.

77' A cross by Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Manchester Utd.
75' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) picks up a long through ball, but Andre Onana deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
71' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
70' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
68' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
66' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.

65' Manchester Utd exchange some short passes over a small area and control the game. Now they make a mistake and lose the ball and the whole situation changes completely. The ball has crossed the sideline. Newcastle are taking a throw-in.
61' Erik ten Hag has decided to substitute Marcus Rashford and he is replaced by Antony (Manchester United).
61' A substitution has been made. Anthony Martial goes off and Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) comes on.
60' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.

58' Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) takes a shot after receiving a good pass, but his effort from the edge of the box goes just over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Manchester Utd will have a goal kick.

55' 1 - 0 Goal Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd)! Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) was put through by Kieran Trippier and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to fire into the bottom left corner. 1:0.

55' Great solo effort by Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) as he beats two defenders before unleashing a low drive from just outside of the box towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper is ready and makes a decent save.
51' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
50' Poor challenge! Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) is penalised for tripping and Robert Jones blows his whistle.
49' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) sends the corner into the box, but Andre Onana intercepts it and averts the threat.
48' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' Robert Jones blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.

45+1' A short pass finds Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd). He spots the keeper off his line and shoots from mid-range, but the ball sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Manchester Utd will have a goal kick.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
45' Jamaal Lascelles (Newcastle Utd) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
45' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) will deliver the corner kick.
44' Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The linesman makes the right call and Newcastle will have a corner.
39' It should have been a goal! Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) fires a rocket of a shot but it only hits the crossbar!

39' It seems like Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) is about to take a free kick. The goalkeeper has to be alert and careful how to position the defensive wall. This is the perfect distance for a direct shot.
37' Harry Maguire (Manchester United) trips an opposition player and Robert Jones signals a foul. Newcastle are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.

35' Close! Miguel Almiron (Newcastle Utd) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot narrowly over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Manchester Utd will have a goal kick.
33' A defender mistimes his tackle on the edge on the box and let's in Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd). It's a decent effort but his shot flies just wide of the right post.
32' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
29' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) swings in a cross from the corner, but Andre Onana reads it well and gathers the ball.

29' Lewis Miley (Newcastle Utd) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Newcastle will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
26' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
25' A pass by Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.

21' Jamaal Lascelles (Newcastle Utd) blows a huge opportunity! He latches on to a perfect cross from the wing into the penalty area, but sends a bullet header narrowly over the crossbar! The ball goes out of play and Manchester Utd will have a goal kick.
21' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) takes the corner with a short pass.
20' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition. It will be a corner kick for Newcastle.
19' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) takes the rebound on the edge of the box and fires the ball just over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Manchester Utd.

17' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Miguel Almiron (Newcastle Utd) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Andre Onana pulls off a brilliant save.

17' A rebound falls to Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) who knows what to do with it. He drills a low shot from the edge of the penalty box, but Andre Onana anticipates his intention and denies him with a nice quick save.
16' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
13' Aaron Wan-Bissaka (Manchester United) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
12' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.

11' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He fires a low shot towards the left side of the net, but Nick Pope leaps like a salmon to deny him.
9' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
7' The resulting corner from Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) is cleared by the defence.
6' Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared. The ball goes out of play and Newcastle have been awarded a corner kick.
5' Newcastle are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears.
3' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
2' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) attempts to release Miguel Almiron with a through ball, but his effort is thwarted by one of the defending players.
1' The match has just started.
Newcastle will kick-off.
Robert Jones is introduced as the referee for today's match.
